question: What is the title of the post with the oldest post link?
evidence: the oldest post link refers to MIN(CreaionDate);
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching postLinks record.
gold: SELECT T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 LEFT JOIN postLinks AS T2 ON T2.PostId = T1.Id ORDER BY T1.CreaionDate LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postLinks AS T2 ON T2.PostId = T1.Id ORDER BY T1.CreaionDate LIMIT 1

b.request: Find the title of the post (using a LEFT JOIN from posts to postLinks, so posts with no matching postLinks record are kept) that has the earliest creation date (MIN of the posts' CreaionDate) among posts linked in postLinks
b.sql: SELECT T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 LEFT JOIN postLinks AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T2.PostId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.CreaionDate ASC LIMIT 1

c.sql: SELECT p.Title FROM posts p LEFT JOIN postLinks pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.CreaionDate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.CreaionDate ASC LIMIT 1

d.request: What is the title of the post with the oldest post link (the earliest CreationDate in postLinks), while also keeping posts that have no matching postLinks record in the results?
d.sql: SELECT p.Title FROM posts p LEFT JOIN postLinks pl ON p.Id = pl.PostId WHERE pl.CreationDate = (SELECT MIN(CreationDate) FROM postLinks)
